body:
This is indeed a tricky use case, but since people don't usually count the number of results in a "page" with infinite hits, this workaround is safe to apply. 

Algolia itself offers no features to deal with it, since searching is seen as stateless for the engine. 

It can be interesting for you to consider using "refresh" once a "waitTask" is finished (at least in a button, like how Twitter does it). https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=Refresh.default
